slides.title: Three questions for the end of a *hard day*
What did I feel that I didn't say?
slides.body: Not what you should have said. Just what was there. Name it, even if it's only to yourself.

slides.title: Where did I run on autopilot?
slides.body: The snapped reply. The scroll. The yes you didn't mean. Autopilot is where old patterns live.

slides.title: What's one thing for tomorrow?
slides.body: One. Not a new life plan. Something small enough that you'll actually do it.
